title: A lost decade: the 1980s and the Baker and Brady plans
goal: Read why CEPAL called the 1980s a lost decade and how the Baker and Brady plans tried to ease the debt, citing sources with según.
grammar: reporting information and citing sources with según

items: I can say what CEPAL called the 1980s and why.
I can say what happened to the debt during the decade.
I can explain what the Baker Plan of 1985 and the Brady Plan of 1989 proposed.
I can cite a source with *según* and report what it says.
